translation: there, present; with it; and yet

sentences.en: Do you have money on you?
Do you have your books with you?

meanings.gloss: with it, in doing so; in the middle of

sentences.en: Can you help me with it?
You can learn a lot doing that.

sentences.text: Er hat dabei sein Geld verloren.
sentences.en: He lost his money in the process.

sentences.text: Ich bin gerade dabei, etwas zu essen.
sentences.en: I'm just in the middle of eating something.

sentences.text: Er hat keine Zeit, dabei hat er nichts zu tun.
sentences.en: He has no time, and yet he has nothing to do.

sentences.text: Sie sagt, sie hat kein Geld. Dabei hat sie gestern ein Auto gekauft.
sentences.en: She says she has no money. And yet she bought a car yesterday.

sentences.text: Er spricht kein Französisch, dabei war er drei Jahre in Paris.
sentences.en: He doesn't speak French, even though he was in Paris for three years.

sentences.text: Sie ist allein, dabei hat sie eine große Familie.
sentences.en: She's alone, even though she has a big family.
